name: Short link, co-rotating — lower link drives
note: Two short links on a seat-tube bracket and a mid-frame pivot. The lower link carries the shock eye up and forward of the seat tube, and the shock runs forward to a 40mm-off mount on the down tube's upper side. The two links turn in opposite senses here (rotA and rotR differ in sign), so this is not the co-rotating layout the name describes: co-rotation could not be found with the shock off both tubes.
draft: links do not co-rotate, so it is not the named design
